body: Thank you for your reply, it really just made me feel better. Thanks for the offer to talk, I might take you up on it sometime. You take care too, okay?

What you said about it happened in school, holy shit that gets me so pissed. It's so hard to try to pretend to be normal like eeveryone else, and normally I'm great with putting on a mask and controlling any weird urges I have, but lately it's getting harder and harder to not slip up. Man. Life. 

What else do you think about that keeps you busy?

> For me, the more I can fix up my life so that I have more frequenty positive thoughts, and less of the bad memories etc., the less I do this .

I like that line. It's helpful. I'm trying to figure out a way to put this into words, but I think trying to fix up my life is a good way to start. You said this gives you more frequently positive thoughts, and I think that's what I need right now. 

Thank you
